input.content:
import re, collections

x = open('sitemap.xml', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
locs = re.findall(r'<loc>(.*?)</loc>', x)
print("total locs:", len(locs), "unique:", len(set(locs)))

langs = ['pt', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'ko', 'it', 'ar', 'zh', 'ja', 'sv']
buck = collections.Counter()
en_sections = collections.Counter()

for u in locs:
    p = u.replace('https://wxrks.com', '').strip('/')
    parts = p.split('/') if p else []
    first = parts[0] if parts else '(home)'
    if first in langs:
        buck['LANG:' + first] += 1
    else:
        buck['EN'] += 1
        en_sections[first if parts else '(home)'] += 1

print("\n-- by language bucket --")
for k, v in buck.most_common():
    print("%7d  %s" % (v, k))

print("\n-- EN top-level sections --")
for k, v in en_sections.most_common(40):
    print("%7d  %s" % (v, k))

en = [u for u in set(locs) if (u.replace('https://wxrks.com', '').strip('/').split('/')[0] or '(home)') not in langs]
print("\nunique EN urls:", len(en))
open('en_urls.txt', 'w').write("\n".join(sorted(en)))
open('all_urls.txt', 'w').write("\n".join(sorted(set(locs))))

"""Summarize crawl results: totals, boilerplate, per-section and per-language breakdown."""
import json, re, sys, collections

S = '<work folder>'
WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9A-Za-zÀ-ɏͰ-ϿЀ-ӿ֐-׿؀-ۿ]+(?:['’-][0-9A-Za-zÀ-ɏ]+)*")
LANGS = ['pt', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'ko', 'it', 'ar', 'zh', 'ja', 'sv']


def load(path):
    rows = []
    for line in open(path, encoding='utf-8'):
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            rows.append(json.loads(line))
    return rows


def boilerplate(pages, thresh=0.9):
    """Longest word-level prefix and suffix shared by >=thresh of pages."""
    toks = [WORD_RE.findall(p['text']) for p in pages if p.get('text')]
    toks = [t for t in toks if len(t) > 20]
    if not toks:
        return 0, 0, [], []
    n = len(toks)
    need = int(n * thresh)

    def longest(seqs, rev):
        ref = max(seqs, key=len)
        ref = ref[::-1] if rev else ref
        lo, hi = 0, min(400, len(ref))
        best = 0
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            pat = ref[:mid]
            cnt = 0
            for s in seqs:
                ss = s[::-1] if rev else s
                if ss[:mid] == pat:
                    cnt += 1
            if cnt >= need:
                best = mid
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid - 1
        pat = ref[:best]
        return best, (pat[::-1] if rev else pat)

    pl, pw = longest(toks, False)
    sl, sw = longest(toks, True)
    return pl, sl, pw, sw


def section(url):
    p = url.replace('https://wxrks.com', '').strip('/')
    parts = p.split('/') if p else []
    if not parts:
        return '(homepage)'
    return parts[0]


def lang_of(url):
    s = section(url)
    return s if s in LANGS else 'en'


def summarize(name, pages):
    ok = [p for p in pages if 'words' in p]
    err = [p for p in pages if 'error' in p]
    tot = sum(p['words'] for p in ok)
    cjk = sum(p.get('cjk_chars', 0) for p in ok)
    print('\n=== %s ===' % name)
    print('pages crawled OK : %d   (errors: %d)' % (len(ok), len(err)))
    print('total words (whitespace/latin tokens): %d' % tot)
    if cjk:
        print('CJK characters (not whitespace-separated): %d' % cjk)
    if ok:
        print('mean words/page  : %.0f   median: %d' % (
            tot / len(ok), sorted(p['words'] for p in ok)[len(ok) // 2]))
    if err:
        c = collections.Counter(str(p['error'])[:60] for p in err)
        print('error kinds:', dict(c.most_common(5)))
    return ok, tot, cjk, err


if __name__ == '__main__':
    en = load(S + 'en_out.jsonl')
    ok_en, tot_en, cjk_en, err_en = summarize('ENGLISH SITE', en)

    pl, sl, pw, sw = boilerplate(ok_en)
    chrome = pl + sl
    print('\n-- repeated chrome (nav + footer) --')
    print('shared prefix words: %d' % pl)
    print('shared suffix words: %d' % sl)
    print('chrome per page    : %d words' % chrome)
    uniq = tot_en - chrome * len(ok_en) + chrome
    print('unique body content (chrome counted once): %d words' % uniq)
    print('prefix starts: %s ...' % ' '.join(pw[:14]))
    print('suffix ends  : ... %s' % ' '.join(sw[-14:]))

    print('\n-- EN words by section --')
    bysec = collections.Counter()
    cntsec = collections.Counter()
    for p in ok_en:
        s = section(p['url'])
        bysec[s] += max(0, p['words'] - chrome)
        cntsec[s] += 1
    for s, w in bysec.most_common(15):
        print('%9d body words  %5d pages  %s' % (w, cntsec[s], s))

    # longest pages
    print('\n-- longest EN pages --')
    for p in sorted(ok_en, key=lambda d: -d['words'])[:5]:
        print('%7d  %s' % (p['words'], p['url']))

    try:
        non = load(S + 'nonen_out.jsonl')
    except FileNotFoundError:
        non = []
    if non:
        ok_n, tot_n, cjk_n, err_n = summarize('TRANSLATED PAGES', non)
        print('\n-- by language --')
        bl = collections.Counter(); bc = collections.Counter(); bj = collections.Counter()
        for p in ok_n:
            lg = lang_of(p['url'])
            bl[lg] += p['words']; bc[lg] += 1; bj[lg] += p.get('cjk_chars', 0)
        for lg, w in bl.most_common():
            extra = '  + %d CJK chars' % bj[lg] if bj[lg] > 1000 else ''
            print('%4s: %9d words  (%4d pages)%s' % (lg, w, bc[lg], extra))
        print('\nGRAND TOTAL all %d pages: %d words' % (len(ok_en) + len(ok_n), tot_en + tot_n))
        print('  + %d CJK characters in zh/ja (no spaces between words)' % (cjk_en + cjk_n))
